assessment_context: Human and musculoskeletal robot sit side by side at an assembly workstation, sharing a tool rack. Human does fine manipulation requiring judgment; robot handles heavier or closer items. Timing/coordination errors can lead to simultaneous reaching, blocking, and minor physical contact or collision.
interaction_modalities: ["verbal (robot speaks short phrases like '我来拿这个' or '你先拿')", 'visual (human observes robot arm pauses, yields, changes path, or retracts)']
collaboration_pattern: Human takes finer, judgment-required items; robot takes heavier or items closer to its side.
environmental_setting: assembly workstation with shared tool rack
expected_empathy_forms: leaving space for human at the shared tool rack
considering human's spatial comfort and proximity
contrast_points: Traditional rigid robot arms have clear work boundaries; human does not share the same pick-up area. This musculoskeletal robot sits right next to the human, sharing the same space, making arm trajectories and upper‑body distance feel more like human‑human collaboration.
failure_modes: both reaching for the same shelf part at the same time
one party assuming the other has seen their reach
blocking or brushing against the human
contact without any pause, avoidance, or explanation
name: human_and_musculoskeletal_robot_sit_side_2026-05-11_155408
